description: Gestor de Residuos de Construcción y Demolición (RCD). Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. Disposición final de RCD: proceso destinado para recibir y acopiar de forma definitiva el material residual del aprovechamiento en las plantas y todo aquel RCD que por sus características físicas no pudo ser objeto de aprovechamiento. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. Its tags are Aprovechamiento, Disposición, Recuperadores, Residuos, Tratamiento Residuos de construcción y demolición. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2025-12-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
